product_metadata.title: True Zoo U Ice of A, Silicone Ice Cube Tray, USA Ice Mold, Novelty Ice July 4th Party Supplies, Dishwasher Safe, Blue, 38 Cubes
features: EASY-TO-REMOVE FROZEN STATES - Measuring 8 inches long, this silicone ice tray is crafted to the shape of American states (sorry Alaska and Hawaii). Simply pour-in your favorite fillings, freeze, and remove the icicles from the non-stick surface.

CREATE A RANGE OF TASTY TREATS - Alongside being great for making ice, this freezer ice tray is ideal for making a range of tasty treats. Make Jell-o, candies, frozen baby foods, ice cream, whiskey, and more!
DISHWASHER SAFE FOOD-GRADE MATERIALS - This ice tray is crafted from silicone that is both dishwasher and oven safe. As such, this reusable ice tray is easy to keep clean.

THE PERFECT GIFT for any proud American - This rubber United States ice tray is a cool gift for 4th July, Christmas, birthdays, thanksgiving, and more. It is also great for parties and American celebrations.

YOUR DAILY DOSE OF JOY - TrueZoo makes useful things fun and fun things useful with practical novelty barware accessories and household products for the young at heart. Breathe life into the everyday with quirky monsters and charming animal companions.
description: No matter what state you're in, it's cool to be an American. So whether you're drunk, sober or in New Hampshire, here are 48 ways to chill your drink the old fashioned way. Who said geography had to be boring? Makes easy-to-remove frozen states Dishwasher and oven safe silicone Also great for making crayons, Jell-O shots, chocolates, and more! Tray measures 8 inches long Our apologies to Alaska and Hawaii
